source: Village OS x Jared plan v3 (8 Nov 2026) section 3, from Amora's working list of structures (April 2026) and Amora's memory, joined with the 23 keys on Amora's live map (scene v6, read 8 Nov 2026). places.name: Caretaker's house (the Rancho)
places.positionText: Right next to the cafe and the waterfall
places.description: The caretaker's home, and the one home built today. Renovated (bath, casita and floor) for a summer program that is no longer coming. Proposed as the school for 10 to 15 children, adding tent classrooms as it grows (candidate proposal, 3 Nov). An April idea to replace it with a greenhouse medicine garden was set aside.
